text:
eva: Quick proposal: run 2-week boxed DP cohorts (fixed window) instead of open rolling invites. helps apples-to-apples feedback and faster signal.
omar: curious — what's the expected throughput?
eva: aiming for 6-10 partners per cohort, concentrated feedback, with 2 "heavy" integration pilots.
meera: risks: lower signups vs rolling. needs tighter recruiting cadence + clear perks.
sam: perks we can offer: priority onboarding, direct feature triage, co-marketing blurb (optional). also 1:1 onboarding session.
eva: suggested success metrics: 
- 6+ partners completing cohort commitments (>=2 live sessions + weekly async)
- >=2 integration pilots sending >4k tokens/day for >=3 days
- >=5 actionable GH issues per cohort (repro steps / impact / owner)
- no P0 regressions (latency/cost/accuracy) vs baseline
meera: add a feedback quality metric: at least 3 reproducible bugs or spec proposals per cohort.
eva: added. nice.
sam: ops question: do we promise dedicated capacity? some partners may ask.
omar: proposal: hosted by default, reserve small dedicated pool + routing fallback to cheaper variant if overloaded. document SLA expectations in invite.
meera: recruitment screener (keep short) — sample:
```
1) primary workload (chat/generate/embeddings)
2) expected daily tokens (est range)
3) product stage (prototype / shipping)
4) data sensitivity (can share redacted traces?)
5) willingness for short integration test (Y/N)
```
meera: keep under 5 fields, binary where possible.
nina-legal: on "share traces" language: please use "share redacted traces" and offer DPA addendum for customers with stricter regs. avoid broad trace-sharing opt-ins.
eva: nina, can you drop legal-approved wording?
nina-legal: will post suggested clause by EOD.
sam: I'll draft the invite email + landing page copy tomorrow morning. short, explicit ask, timebox, and perks list.
meera: feedback loop plan: weekly 60min sync, async Notion pulse with template (prompts, golden outputs, issues), and end-of-cohort eval checklist. capture prompt sets for regression harness.
omar: runtime/infra will run eval harness after each deploy against saved golden outputs. we need owners for prompt repo.
meera: product (meera) owns prompt sets; eng-runtime (omar) owns harness infra. pair Monday to wire up.
sam: I'll set up the Notion template and facilitation notes.
eva: timeline: 1wk recruit, 2wk active, 1wk wrap/eval = 4wk pilot. target start = 3wks out.
meera: public beta gating: >=80% actionables triaged (fixed or scheduled), no P1/P0 regressions, engagement thresholds met.
eva: if gating fails, repeat cohort with adjustments.
sam: also suggest a "drop-in" path for partners who can't do full sync cadence (keep funnel healthy). mark optional in screener.
meera: agreed. include optional path.
deploy-bot: note: no deploys scheduled against DP pool for next 7 days.
eva: final ops/communication asks: create single feedback channel (prod-dp-feedback) with sam/meera as admins; GH repo for cohort artifacts; assign owners on roadmap card.
sam: creating channel and repo now, will post invites + link later today. :thumbsup:
meera: pairing for eval harness Monday 10am PT?
omar: confirmed.
eva: thanks everyone. I'll spin up initial GH repo and add a roadmapped card with owners.
